title: 13:14 as the hunted deer/as a sheep that no man taketh up. Isaiah compares a wicked person during the judgments of the last days to deer and sheep. A hunted deer is endangered when hunters are present, and sheep are endangered when shepherds are absent. The imagery implies that the wicked will be like a hunted deer; they will flee for their lives during this time (there will be wars—Matt. 24:6), and they will be like unprotected sheep, meaning those who have not accepted Jesus as their shepherd may not receive his protection.
author: Tina M. Peterson
